;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Iran–United States relations]], [[June 2019 Iranian shoot-down of American drone]]
**[[Iran]]'s [[Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps]] shoots down an [[United States|American]] [[Northrop Grumman RQ-4 Global Hawk|RQ-4 Global Hawk]] [[Unmanned aerial vehicle|spy drone]] after it allegedly violates Iranian airspace. [https://www.rte.ie/amp/1056415/ (RTÉ)]
**An anonymous American official says the incident occurred in international airspace, and not over Iranian territory. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/us-official-confirms-iran-shot-down-drone-says-it-was-in-international-airspace/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
**[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]], when asked about the strike, says it is "hard to believe it was intentional". He later approves retaliatory military attacks against Iranian missile and radar facilities, but subsequently changes his mind. [https://www.cnn.com/2019/06/20/politics/trump-iran-drone-downing/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-48714414 (BBC News)]

;Business and economics
*The [[United States Department of Justice Antitrust Division|Antitrust Division]] of the [[United States Department of Justice|U.S. Justice Department]] files a lawsuit against two large printing companies contemplating a [[Mergers and acquisitions|merger]]. If the deal is allowed to proceed, the filings claim, the combined company would dominate the market for printing magazines, catalogs and books. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-lsc-commns-m-a-quad-graphics/u-s-sues-to-stop-merger-of-two-printing-companies-idUSKCN1TL2RD (Reuters)]

;Disasters and accidents
*At least 44 people are killed when a bus carrying at least 60 plunges into a gorge in the [[Kullu district]] of [[Himachal Pradesh]], a mountainous northern [[India]]n state. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-india-48714871 (BBC News)]

;International relations 
*[[Kim–Xi meetings]], [[China–North Korea relations]]
**[[Communist Party of China|Chinese Communist Party]] [[General Secretary of the Communist Party of China|general secretary]] [[Xi Jinping]] arrives in [[North Korea]] for a two-day state visit with [[Workers' Party of Korea|Korean Workers' Party]] [[Chairman of the Workers' Party of Korea|chairman]] [[Kim Jong-un]]. [https://www.latimes.com/world/la-fg-china-north-korea-20190619-story.html (''Los Angeles Times'')]
*[[Venezuelan refugee crisis]], [[Colombia–Venezuela relations]]
**The [[Military Forces of Colombia|Colombian military]] reveals that [[FARC dissidents|dissident FARC groups]], in spite of [[Colombian peace process|a 2016 treaty]], have been recruiting Venezuelan migrants at illegal border crossings, strengthening their numbers and increasing attacks. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-venezuela-politics-colombia-exclusive/exclusive-colombian-armed-groups-recruiting-desperate-venezuelans-army-says-idUSKCN1TL14E (Reuters)]

;Law and crime
*[[Security hacker|Computer ransomware]]
**[[Riviera Beach, Florida]], is paying $600,000  to a hacker who [[Malware|took over]] local government computers three weeks ago. [https://www.cnn.com/2019/06/20/us/riviera-beach-to-pay-hacker/index.html (CNN)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2019 Guatemalan general election]]
**After days of disagreements, allegations of electoral fraud and several inconsistencies with the preliminary results of the general election held last Sunday, the [[Supreme Electoral Tribunal (Guatemala)|Supreme Electoral Tribunal]] orders a new review of the electoral records and restarts the count. [https://www.prensalibre.com/guatemala/politica/tse-anuncia-que-revisara-acta-por-acta-ante-denuncias-por-anomalias/ (''Prensa Libre'')]
*[[2019 Conservative Party leadership election]]
**[[Home Secretary]] [[Sajid Javid]] is eliminated after coming in fourth place in the fourth round of voting. [[Boris Johnson]] remains the front runner,  with [[Michael Gove]] and [[Jeremy Hunt]] coming in second and third place respectively. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-politics-48707448 (BBC News)]
**In the fifth round of voting, Gove is controversially eliminated. The party membership run-off vote will be between Johnson and Hunt. [https://www.theguardian.com/politics/live/2019/jun/20/tory-leadership-latest-news-final-two-boris-johnson-hammond-results-latest-final-two-boris-johnson-hammond-tells-candidates-to-be-honest-with-public-about-brexit-options-live-news (''The Guardian'')] 
*[[2020 United States Senate election in Alabama]]
**[[Roy Moore]] announces that he will run for [[United States Senate|U.S. Senate]] again in [[Alabama]], defying the wishes of [[Donald Trump]] and the [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican Party]]. [https://www.cnbc.com/amp/2019/06/20/roy-moore-will-run-for-senate-in-alabama-after-trump-objects.html (CNBC)] 


;Arts and culture
